property_summary: Only calls from DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT can successfully update the L1 block fields; all other callers must cause setL1BlockValues to revert and leave public fields unchanged.
Calling setL1BlockValues either reverts (no state change) or sets all public L1 fields exactly to the provided input values when it succeeds.

Calling setL1BlockValues from the depositor account updates sequenceNumber to the provided value and does not change the contract's balance; if it reverts (non-depositor), sequenceNumber remains unchanged.

A call to setL1BlockValues either reverts (leaving all observed public L1 fields unchanged) or succeeds and sets every public L1 field to the provided input; in either case the contract's ETH balance does not change.
